description: Get a signed URL to PUT one local image, video or audio file (up to 25 MiB). Upload is free, but requires a positive balance. After PUT succeeds, use publicUrl as a generation input. The upload URL expires in 10 minutes; at most 20 URLs per minute per user.

contentLength.description: Exact file size in bytes. The upload must have this size.

contentType.description: MIME type of the input file.

name: create_upload_url
title: Create input upload URL
